focus_area_title: Develop a Habit of Recognizing People Who Take Risks
content_text_body:
Recognizing and thanking your team members for taking appropriate risks that have the potential to improve the company is one of the simplest and most effective ways to promote effective risk-taking behavior among your team. The goal is to create a regular cadence for doing this. 

For starters, read this brief article on [How to Recognize Game-Changing Ideas](https://www.inc.com/will-yakowicz/heres-why-you-are-really-bad-at-recognizing-great-ideas.html).

Try to come up with innovative ways to recognize and reward innovation. To get some ideas, read this article on [How to Reward Great Ideas](https://www.inc.com/guides/201107/how-to-reward-employees-great-ideas.html).

### For one week, just observe

Jot down all of your team's innovative actions or risks that deserve recognition. Review the list at the end of each day.

### Practice every day

Consistently say "thank youâ€ for all creative efforts. 

Let your team know what they did, why it was important for the team and the business - and whenever possible - what others are saying about it. 

### Get your team involved

Your team may interact with each other more than they interact with you. Ask your team to acknowledge each other for taking informed risks. Create a culture where everyone values forward-thinking actions.

### Create a feedback loop

Ask your team to give you feedback at the end of each week on how consistently you're supporting risk-taking behavior.
